# UtilsNow — Free Online Tools

> https://utilsnow.com — 220+ free browser-based utility tools. No signup. No data uploaded. Runs entirely in your browser.

## About
UtilsNow is a free online tools website with 220+ utilities across 17 categories for developers, designers, students, and professionals. Every tool runs entirely in your browser — no data leaves your device. No login required.

## Privacy & Security
All tool processing happens 100% client-side in the user's browser. No data is uploaded, stored, or transmitted to any server. No cookies for tracking. No login or account required. HTTPS enforced.

## Technical Details
- Framework: Next.js 16 (Turbopack, App Router)
- Language: TypeScript
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4
- 10 UI languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Turkish
